title: How to Write Your Resume Work Experience So You Land Interviews
description:
Your resume's "Work Experience" section is the bridge that builds the connection from everything you've done professionally to all that you're capable of in your next role.

In fact, it's the most vital section for highlighting how well you're qualified for a new position.

With that in mind, how can you showcase your work history in a way that reveals depth, relevance, and impact so you can apply for your next job with credibility, clarity, and confidence?  

In this video, we'll go over:

00:00 Introduction
00:28 What's a "work experience" section?
01:00 Why is resume work experience so important?
01:19 Example of GOOD resume achievements
02:23 How to write your resume work experience
04:05 Best tip for writing resume achievements
04:59 Teal's Achievement Assistant tool can help write resume work experience
06:00 What to write if you don't have experience
06:52 Make sure most relevant achievements are first
07:08 Recap & conclusion
